title: Poltergeist rule file
description: A rules.json file: either an array of rules or an object with a 'rules' array. Time meters (timeOnSite, timeSinceActive, timeAway) are in seconds, scrollDistance is in pixels. timeAway is the longest time the page was hidden since the last reset. JSON Schema draft-07 style.

rampTo.description: Meter value at which intensity reaches 1. Must be > threshold. Omit for a flat intensity of 1.

params-ritual.description: Params of the ritual effect: a full-page candle puzzle. Draw one path through every square, passing the numbered candles in order. Finishing it reports the "exorcised" action; blocks interaction once intensity reaches blockAt. Documentation only: the validator does not read this definition. Any value of the wrong type or outside its range uses the default.

heading.default: Light the candles to banish the ghost
heading.description: Heading text, 1 to 200 characters. Default "Light the candles to banish the ghost". Other values use the default.

instructions.default: Draw one path through every square, passing the candles in order.
instructions.description: Instruction text, 1 to 300 characters. Default "Draw one path through every square, passing the candles in order.". Other values use the default.

size.description: Board size in squares per side. Integer from 3 to 7. Default 5. Other values use the default.

candles.description: Number of candles. Integer from 2 to 9, and at most size x size. Default 5. Other values use the default.

sound.description: Play a short generated chime when the last candle lights. Only the boolean true turns it on. Default false.

maxOpacity.description: Overlay opacity at intensity 1. Number from 0 to 1. Default 0.96. Other values use the default.

blockAt.description: Intensity at which the overlay blocks pointer input and takes focus. Number from 0 to 1. Default 1. Other values use the default.
